product_overview: A property rental marketplace where travelers can search and book stays, save favorites, and message hosts. Hosts can manage listings, review reservations, and track performance from a dashboard.
core_goals: Find rental properties by destination, filters, and categories
View detailed property information before booking
Reserve a property for selected dates
Save properties to a wishlist for later review
Message hosts and guests through direct chat
Manage hosted properties and reservations from a host dashboard

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account, sign in, and complete password recovery through OTP-based verification and reset steps.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in the registration details -> Continue through the signup steps -> Enter the received verification code -> Complete account creation
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit login form -> See the authenticated experience

Navigate to /forgot-password -> Submit account email for recovery -> Navigate to /verify-otp -> Enter the received verification code -> Navigate to /reset-password -> Set a new password -> Complete password reset
Navigate to /register -> Fill in the registration details with invalid or incomplete information -> Continue through the signup steps -> See form validation feedback
Navigate to /verify-otp -> Enter an incorrect verification code -> Submit the code -> See verification failure feedback
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter mismatched or invalid password values -> Submit the reset form -> See password validation feedback

features.name: Search and Filter Listings
features.description: Users can browse available properties on the home page, narrow results with filters, and explore listings by category.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a destination query -> Adjust price, guest, and rating filters -> Select a category tab -> See the filtered property results
Navigate to / -> Adjust filters without entering a destination -> Review the updated listing results
Navigate to / -> Select a category tab -> Compare the visible property cards in that category

features.name: View Property Details
features.description: Users can open a property page to review photos, descriptions, map location, and guest reviews before deciding to book.
user_flows: Navigate to /properties/:id -> View the property photos -> Read the property description and details -> Review guest ratings and comments -> View the property location on the map
Navigate to /properties/:id -> Inspect the gallery and location information -> Compare the amenity and review information before making a booking decision

features.name: Book a Property
features.description: Authenticated travelers can choose stay dates, review pricing, and complete a reservation with the checkout flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /properties/:id -> Select check-in and check-out dates -> Review the calculated price -> Proceed to reserve the property -> Complete the checkout flow -> See booking confirmation
Navigate to /properties/:id -> Select unavailable or invalid date values -> Attempt to reserve the property -> See date validation feedback
Navigate to /properties/:id -> Select stay dates -> Review the price summary -> Start checkout -> Review the payment overlay -> Complete the booking

features.name: Guest Host Direct Chat
features.description: Authenticated users can open a conversation with a host or guest and exchange messages in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to /inbox -> Open an existing conversation -> Read recent messages -> Type a reply -> Send the message -> See the conversation update in real time
Navigate to /properties/:id -> Open the related conversation from the property context -> Read the chat thread -> Send a message to the host -> See the message appear in the inbox thread
Navigate to /inbox -> Open a conversation -> Type a message -> Send the message -> Read the updated message history

features.name: Host Dashboard Management
features.description: Hosts can review performance metrics, manage their property listings, and inspect upcoming reservations from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /host/dashboard -> Review revenue metrics and listing summaries -> Open the property management flow -> Create a new property listing -> Return to the dashboard -> See the new listing reflected
Navigate to /host/add-property -> Enter property details -> Submit the new listing -> Return to the dashboard -> See the property in the hosted listings
Navigate to /host/dashboard -> Select an existing property for editing -> Update listing details -> Save changes -> Return to the dashboard -> See the updated property information
Navigate to /host/dashboard -> Open a property for removal -> Delete the listing -> Return to the dashboard -> See the listing removed
Navigate to /host/dashboard -> Review upcoming reservations -> Inspect reservation details for hosted properties
